comment: Extremely intelligent individual who is passionate about what he does. He helps you with language without making you feel inferior or stupid at any time. Doesn't just give textbook assignments- he makes it come alive through poetry, music, etc.
Very good interdisciplinary class on theater in Spanish America. Beware: lots of reading and you will have to act. The lectures are challenging. I would take this class again.

Very helpful outside of class, you can literally sit with him and discuss what your paper will say. Somewhat difficult to understand and DEFINITELY repetitive in the course's schedule, but really enthusiastic about justice and politics and Chile! He was also really helpful with my study abroad questions, going above and beyond his job requirements.
Prof. Izquierdo is tough yet available out of class for clarification. His lectures are challenging.
Nice guy, tough teacher, can be very unclear when it comes to essays and tests. Didn't learn all that much

Very nice young professor from Chile. Easy to understand and very helpful. The class had interesting readings/films and was a pretty easy grader. He uses the same method over and over which gets redundant.
